notes: Scanned PDF: no extractable text (pdftotext returns only a watermark '微信公众号：桃李百科'); all content read visually from rendered page images.
Cover says 英语 预备级 (starter level), 一年级上册. The whole volume is a starter course: 6 short units (6 pages each), no alphabet/letters or phonics are taught in Unit 1.

Unit 1 is a greetings/self-introduction unit: it has no concrete picture nouns (only function words + 'photo'). For a picture-card game, the four characters (Taotao, Duoduo, Toby, Emma) and the greeting situations are the natural card images; concrete nouns start in Unit 2 (numbers, balloon).
Word list en/zh taken verbatim from the book's appendix 'Words and expressions' (book p62, PDF p68). The book notes that bold words are 义务教育英语课程标准二级词汇; in Unit 1 every word looks bold except 'photo'.

Sentence/dialogue Chinese translations are NOT printed in the book – they are my translations for the game. Names' Chinese characters are given in the book only for Taotao 淘淘, Duoduo 多多, Toby 托比, Emma 埃玛.
'page' = printed book page number; 'pdf_page' = page index in the PDF (book page + 4 for pp.1-61).
The book uses the icons: headphones = audio, play button = video/animation.
